lessons: 19.P3.serve-activation (CHUPA_PLAN.md:2256) requires triage/Author Driver and Effects to use checkout.journal. The fence omits chupa/triage.py and chupa/driver.py, so the seed must be re-authored under 19.L with them inside its fence and caller closure.

Merged chupa/runner.py:108-111 already binds Driver.journal and Effects to checkout.journal after Driver.from_config. Follow that pattern in triage_pass and keep Driver.from_config's signature and its other callers unchanged.

triage_pass is called from chupa/__main__.py:144. On merged HEAD it builds its own Journal through Driver.from_config (chupa/driver.py:159). That would make a second durable writer, which conflicts with the Records contract making Journal the sole durable event writer.

Create tests/test_serve.py yourself. The Verification command exits 4 on the base commit only because that file does not exist yet. This is not a pre-existing failure, so do not file it as a second problem.
